integrity_note: Analytic proof and reproducible finite rational tests supplied. Potential unindexed spectral moment inversions and inaccessible older texts are disclosed. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact population moments of inverse squared Haar-central-section volumes only; no finite-sample estimator or numerical conditioning theorem; congruence recovery, not orientation; generic rather than universal minimality at repeated-axis ellipsoids; not a reconstruction theorem for all convex bodies.
title: Sharp finite-moment reconstruction of ellipsoid axes from unoriented central sections
